final: WITH g AS (SELECT cr.raceId AS raceId, c.country AS country, SUM(cr.points) AS ps, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS av FROM g) SELECT g.raceId, g.country, g.ps, g.cnt, g.cnt - a.av AS diff FROM g JOIN a ON a.av IS NOT NULL WHERE g.cnt > a.av ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
